rationale: No deployed Modulo or Noesis component currently consumes an S3-compatible object API.
Modulo attachments retain their existing attachment-storage authority; migrating that implementation is a separate application change.
Backups remain owned by restic plus Backblaze B2 and must not be mixed with application-object retention.
Creating empty buckets and durable credentials would add cost, review burden and attack surface without serving a current workload.
activationTriggers: A dataset or research output exceeds 100 MiB per object or 10 GiB in aggregate and is not a working file, backup or Git artifact.
A deployed application needs durable binary objects through an S3-compatible API.
Generated artifacts need independent retention or distribution outside GitHub releases and the container registry.
A reviewed Modulo attachment-storage abstraction selects S3 as its backend.
A measured public distribution workload benefits from R2 egress economics and has an approved publication boundary.

providerProfile.credentialCustody: Bitwarden or the workload's approved external secret store; never Git, Modulo notes or shell history

classes.authority: Object storage after explicit dataset registration
classes.allowedContent: Large immutable source or derived datasets that are not working files or backups
classes.forbiddenContent: Secrets, live databases, ordinary synchronized files and backup repositories

classes.allowedContent: Reproducible generated outputs not already owned by GitHub Releases or a container registry
classes.forbiddenContent: Signing keys, deployment credentials and sole copies of source material

classes.allowedContent: Application-managed binary objects whose metadata and deletion state are authoritative elsewhere
classes.forbiddenContent: Untracked files, credentials, database data directories and independent backups

classes.allowedContent: Large exports, corpora and reproducible research outputs
classes.forbiddenContent: Unredacted sensitive source material without a recorded threat review

classes.allowedContent: Intentional immutable archives with a documented source and retention owner
classes.forbiddenContent: Restic repositories, ad hoc dumps and data with no deletion owner
